thread:
lina: Quick ask from Meridian Systems (SI)  they want Datadog + OTLP for their on-prem appliance tile. Main concerns: PII, retention, and a short demo this Thursday. Need a one-pager and owners.

omar: Recommend collector-side forwarding (otelcol -> datadog) so raw telemetry can be sanitized locally. Default sampling: 1% global, 100% for error traces and traces tagged incident=true. Mask free-text prompts: use prompt.hash + prompt.length.

jess: I'll draft the customer one-pager and route to legal. Keep language simple: "Telemetry stays local by default; only sanitized, sampled telemetry is forwarded."

lina: I'll own the demo. I'll build a tiny canary that emits spans with model.id, model.version, request_id, batch_size, seq_len. No prompt text emitted.

omar: Short collector snippet for README (template only):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  attributes/transform:
    actions:
      - action: delete
        key: http.request.body
      - action: delete
        key: user.email
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<DATADOG_APIKEY_PLACEHOLDER>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/transform]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

infra-bot: deploy: meridian-observability-canary v0.1 deployed to staging (tag: meridian-demo-2026-03-25) :rocket:

jess: Preflight checklist to include in tile README: open port 4317, otelcol running (`systemctl status otelcol`), datadog-agent status, example cURL to test local OTLP endpoint, and mapping rule to convert `model.version` -> `model_version` tag.

lina: I'll produce a 20s GIF of the dashboard updating and a minimal dashboard JSON. Timeline: demo Thu, one-pager + PR Tue EOD, demo dry-run Wed.

jess: Great. I'll start legal check and add co-marketing note (no partner logos until signoff). Thanks team :thumbsup:
